predecessor_status: V4 validation and locked test passed; V5 is a stricter endpoint extension, not a repair of a failed V4.
change_reason: V4 passed only a sequential one-step gate that re-read the true state at every step. V5 changes the evaluation, not the learned mechanism: after an 80-transition prefix and one final observed state, predicted latent residuals and predicted chart states are recursively fed back for one uninterrupted 5- and 20-step forecast. The V4 train, selector, intervention, and calibration rules remain fixed; only validation and locked-test seeds are fresh.

overrides.hypothesis: After an 80-transition OOD calibration prefix, the frozen V4 sparse mechanism plus rank-one context state will outperform persistence and its no-latent ablation, outperform fixed-local at H20, and remain noninferior to an equal-probe dense mechanism while true future chart states and residuals are unavailable.
overrides.claim_boundary: This is a four-fully-observed-chart, known-rank-one, shared-AR, matched-basis, directed-budget-two synthetic conditional-mean forecast gate. Validation and test use new stochastic seeds under the same single fixed OOD loading vector, not unseen loading environments. It observes x[0:81], performs calibrated domain adaptation rather than zero-shot transfer, freezes adaptation, and runs freely from x[80] through x[100]. It does not predict stochastic innovations and is not a full-episode autonomous world model, planning, real cortical connectivity, a neural algorithm, or AGI.

latent_filter.online_signal: observed mechanism residuals only through calibration; recursively predicted residual thereafter

rollout.state_recursion: x_hat[t+k] is the next mechanism input
rollout.residual_recursion: r_hat[t+k-1] is the next latent-filter input
rollout.learned_model_source: V4 selected edges, paired-do coefficient estimates, and pooled-train scalar AR stored in the frozen parent artifact
parent_checks: artifact SHA256 equals the preregistered value
parent merged registration SHA256 is unchanged
parent latent and sparse implementation SHA256 values equal current files
rollout.baseline_refit: Fixed observational baselines are deterministically refit from inherited V4 train seeds under the pinned sparse implementation. No V5 validation or test outcome is used for fitting.

model_definitions.fixed_models: recursively feed each model's x_hat into its own next prediction; no residual correction
model_definitions.stable_observational: fit [1, x_target, tanh(x_other charts)] with registered ridge; no cubic term and no coefficient clipping
model_definitions.latent_filter_models: fit each model's own pooled-train scalar AR and its own prefix residual center, rank-one direction, and intercept; recursively feed r_hat and x_hat
model_definitions.causal_latent_free: use frozen sparse V4 D, B, and pooled-train scalar AR
model_definitions.same_probe_dense_latent_free: use all twelve off-diagonal paired-do estimates without thresholding, the same diagonal estimates and probe budget, then fit its own train AR and prefix residual filter
model_definitions.oracle_hidden_diagnostic: use true h[80] only, recurse it with registered latent_ar, and use no future h or process noise

metric_definitions.seed_path_rmse: sqrt(mean squared error over leads 1..H and requested charts) computed separately per seed
metric_definitions.reported_path_rmse: arithmetic mean of independent-seed path RMSE values
metric_definitions.seed_terminal_rmse: sqrt(mean squared error over requested charts at exactly lead H) computed separately per seed
metric_definitions.reported_terminal_rmse: arithmetic mean of independent-seed terminal RMSE values
metric_definitions.paired_ci95_lower: Student-t lower bound on per-seed absolute RMSE difference baseline minus causal_latent_free
metric_definitions.horizon_20_to_5_ratio: reported candidate H20 path RMSE divided by reported candidate H5 path RMSE
metric_definitions.prediction_norm: L2 norm per predicted four-chart state; train q99 pools per-state L2 norms from inherited observational-train episodes
metric_definitions.learned_jacobian: maximum spectral radius over candidate rollout states of diag(D)+B diag(sech(x)^2)

leakage_tests: rollout API accepts only fitted objects, x[79], x[80], and horizon; it cannot accept Episode or future outcomes
mutating x[81:101] leaves predictions bit-identical while scores change
mutating all hidden values leaves every non-oracle prediction bit-identical
H5 prediction equals the first five rows of the single H20 rollout
rollout.evaluation_probe_usage: none; validation and test episodes are purely observational scoring data
